relationships.subject: CX-3
relationships.evidence_quote: CX-3 exhibited equivalent TRPV1 antagonistic activity with classical TRPV1 antagonist BCTC in vitro

relationships.subject: CX-3
relationships.evidence_quote: exerted better analgesic activity in vivo than that of BCTC in the formalin induced inflammatory pain model without hyperthermia risk

key_findings: Flavonoid-skeleton TRPV1 antagonist CX-3 matches BCTC in vitro and is more analgesic in vivo without hyperthermia risk.
CX-3 also lowers glucose and is highly selective over other ion channels.
